description:
Edit an existing widget of an SEO Reporting report. WRITE action — requires the write scope. Only the fields you pass change; everything else is kept. title renames it; metric (clicks, impressions, ctr, position — performance_chart only); periodDays OR from/to (Y-m-d) change the period; viewId OR tags (+ tagType page|keyword) REPLACE all the filters currently on the widget; clearFilter=true removes them; position (1-based) moves the widget. Pass at least one field. Errors: reporting_not_available, not_found (report), widget_not_found, nothing_to_update, invalid_title, invalid_metric, metric_not_supported, invalid_date_range, conflicting_filter, invalid_position, smart_view_not_found, tag_not_found, tag_type_mismatch. Get ids from get_report. Pass the property ID (UUID) or URL (sc-domain:...) from list_properties.

Cost: 1 credit per call.

Examples:
```json
// switch a performance chart from clicks to impressions.
{"property":"sc-domain:example.com","reportId":"00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000","widgetId":"00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002","metric":"impressions"}
```

periodDays.description: Rolling window in days ending on the last data date.

position.description: 1-based position to move the widget to.

tagType.description: Whether tags are page or keyword tags. Default page.

tags.description: Tag names to filter by (from list_tags). Alternative to viewId.

name: update_report_widget

render_with.description: Render tool that can display this payload.

data.description: Stored widget config: period, startDate/endDate (d-m-Y), typeMetric, previous-period dates.

filter.description: The applied filter (Smart View or tag selection), or null when the widget is unfiltered.

title: Update report widget
